title: Glow
description: x-glow gives the element a halo in color, which defaults to the theme's primary colour: a pulsing ring around the box, or with target="text" a steady glow around the letters.

color.description: Colour of the glow. Defaults to the theme primary (`var(--primary, #6366f1)`), so it follows the active theme unless you pin it.

target.description: What glows. "box" haloes the element's rectangle and pulses; "text" haloes the letters with a steady text-shadow, for headings. The pulse stops when the reader prefers reduced motion.
